## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: the consumer wiring of the admitted
   disposition — one disposition function in scheduler/query/results/
   export/compare/analysis/non-partial close (partition consumer row;
   PADR-R5-1 A.1 items 2/4/6, A.9 items 3/5/6; REQ-E-202/REQ-E-008
   primary). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores; consume predecessor
   contracts unchanged — R5.6 `launch_bound`/`grade_binding`, R5.9
   selection/RevisionLog, R5.10 seal/M1, R5.11 invoked/verdict refs,
   R5.13 physical fold (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: one admitted disposition function across every consumer;
   every finish/invocation/verdict/settlement/disposition crash window
   exercised; exactly-once cost transfer (`execution_settled`);
   historical results reproduce at old watermarks (AC-1).
3. Negative: each consumer independently refuses scored success/
   completion while pending; partial close enumerates unresolved slots;
   retry cannot relaunch/recharge/add n; unknown required feature
   refuses; legacy absence preserves behavior byte-for-byte (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: primary REQ-E-202 + REQ-E-008 resolved to
   numbered checks + actual evidence; contributing REQ-E-102/REQ-E-103/
   REQ-E-201/REQ-E-204 mapped; achieved D/E separate from owed R/P/
   actual-execution E; no full-target claim where another owner holds
   the primary (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all
   --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode only if
   touched; commands + counts; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates
   as DEFERRALS rows; ADRs for owned decisions; run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/
   LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 + I-01–I-08 dispositions (AC-5).

- [ ] AC-1 (D/E; positive): one admitted disposition function in

- [ ] AC-2 (D/E; negative): each consumer independently refuses scored

     unresolved slots; retry cannot relaunch/recharge/add n; unknown

- [ ] AC-3 (E; ownership+evidence): primary targets → numbered checks +

- [ ] AC-4 (E/D; scoped verification): fails-without; commands+counts;

- [ ] AC-5 (D/E; universal gate): records agree; REQ stamps; clauses.

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-experiment/src/disposition.rs` (new) — the one admitted
   disposition function `plan_disposition_at(store, docs, experiment_run_id,
   run_plan_id, pins)`: folds ExperimentView ≤ experiment pin; resolves the
   plan's `launch_bound.grade_binding` (mode `legacy` → `Admission::Legacy`;
   `required` → `ValidGradeSet` from the spec.ext freeze + subject seal +
   subject stop class/vetoes); folds `verification.oracle.verdict` rows on
   the pinned overlay/instrument runs → `GradeAttempt`s; folds
   `measurement.experiment.selection_revision` rows → `RevisionLog`;
   composes `select_grade_at` + `plan_disposition`. `DispositionPins`
   `{experiment_until, overlay_runs}` is the `scoring_ref`.
   `required_grade_freeze(spec)` — strict `spec.ext["required_grade"]`
   decode: `{mode:"required", selection_policy_ref, tasks:{task_id:
   {oracle_ref, eligible[]}}}`; unknown mode/member → typed refusal.
2. `engine.rs` — launch builds `grade_binding` from the freeze
   (`mode:"required"` + `selection_policy_ref` member; unknown feature →
   `UnknownRequiredFeature`); settle in required mode for a scored stop
   mints `run_settled{grade_pending:true}` + `execution_settled{plan,
   run, settled_cost_ref, returned_funding_ref, dedup_key}` once (cost
   charge unchanged); `settle_graded(run_plan_id, pins)` — the grade
   admission op: replay recorded `plan_disposition`, Pending → no write,
   Graded/OracleFailure → mint `measurement.experiment.plan_disposition`
   (no recharge, no replan, no new n); `record_selection_revision` —
   authorized revision through `RevisionLog` semantics onto the
   experiment run; `close` — pending plans block non-partial close
   (named `grade_pending=[…]`) and partial close lists them.
3. `view.rs` — `PlanState.grade_pending` fold; `PLAN_DISPOSITION` /
   `SELECTION_REVISION` / `EXECUTION_SETTLED` folds; pending blocks
   `eligible_at`, counts `open_at`; `pending_plans()`.
4. `events.rs` — `grade_binding` + optional `selection_policy_ref`;
   `execution_settled`/`plan_disposition`/`selection_revision` payload
   builders; `run_settled` + `grade_pending` member.
5. `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` + `crates/hh-ontology/src/planes.rs`
   — register the three new classes (CC10 one home).
6. `hh-results` — `ScoringContext.experiment_run: Option<OverlayRef>`
   (additive; absent → legacy); `OutcomeSection.disposition: Option<_>`;
   `project_row` — when bound + pinned, calls `plan_disposition_at`:
   pending withholds `outcome_class` + sets `disposition:"pending"`,
   experiment pin enters `watermark_set`; `export_rows` — pending rows
   refuse `foreign_leaderboard_submission` and list `outcome.disposition`
   loss entries on lowered targets.
7. `hh-eval` — `EvalRun.disposition: Option<String>`; `compare` treats
   `pending` as never-in-denominator, never a scored interpretation.
8. `hh-embed` — `analysis_ops` refuses scored analysis over pending rows.
9. Tests `crates/hh-experiment/tests/r5_14.rs` + consumer legs in
   hh-results/hh-eval/hh-embed; ADR-0393 (owned landing decisions);
   run ledger; PR; close.

  green, 0 regressions) + `cargo fmt --all` clean — **before PR/close**;

  admitted `plan_disposition_at(scoring_ref)` read (`DispositionPins`
  experiment/overlay watermarks) composing freeze decode
  (`spec.ext.required_grade` strict: unknown mode/member/task →
  `UnknownRequiredFeature`; absent → legacy), subject seal/stop/veto,
  R5.11 verdict rows → `GradeAttempt`s, durable revision fold →
  `select_grade_at` + `plan_disposition`; `required_grade_freeze`;
